description: This PHP class 'trellorestInterface' implements an interface to interact with Trello for issue tracking purposes. It manages connection setup, bug ID normalization, status retrieval, and link generation with Trello boards and cards.

classes.name: trellorestInterface
classes.description: A class providing integration with Trello for issue tracking within the system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Trello interface with configuration parameters, establishing connectivity.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes and normalizes configuration parameters for API interaction.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the current API client instance used for Trello interaction.

methods.name: normalizeBugID
methods.description: Normalizes a Trello issue ID to a standardized format, extracting the short ID from URLs.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if a given bug ID conforms to the expected Trello ID format.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection with Trello API using provided credentials.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns boolean indicating whether connection to Trello is established.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL to view a specific Trello card for a bug ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the status code for a given issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns a verbose (human-readable) status string for an issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Gets the HTML string of the issue's summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug ID exists in Trello.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches detailed info about an issue from Trello and constructs an internal object.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for configuration parameters required for Trello integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created via API (False in this implementation).

methods.name: canAddNoteViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether notes can be added via API (False in this implementation).
